title: Tautology is coNP-complete
statement: The language of bit strings whose decoded DNF formula evaluates to true under every Boolean assignment is coNP-complete: it belongs to coNP, and every language in coNP has a polynomial-time many-one reduction to it.
replaced:
The language $\mathrm{TAUTOLOGY}$, of binary strings whose decoded DNF formula is true
under every assignment, is coNP-complete: it belongs to coNP, and
every language in coNP is polynomial-time Karp reducible to it
[AB09, Example~2.21].
